# its 4-letter game ID, then D and the disc revision, or N and the channel's version), exactly
# as WiiLink publishes them at https://wfc.wiilink24.com/patches/<title>.txt (fetched 6 October
# 2026; built from https://github.com/WiiLink24/wfc-patcher-wii, gamedefs.csv). Tamariba's
# Dolphin applies a game's code when the player chose WiiLink WFC (Core/TamaribaWFC.cpp); the
# code then fetches WiiLink's signed payload from its server through the Plaza's exit.
